summary: First-finish smoke pass. Backend endpoints (auth, athletes CRUD, evaluations with all body-fat formulas, weighins, goals, users, viewer 403, monthly report, photo upload/download/delete) all verified working against public URL. Frontend login, dashboard, sidebar nav (new athlete, users, theme toggle) verified via Playwright. Formulas return valid metrics (bf_reilly_wallace=11.41, bf_evans=15.63, bf_jackson_pollock=9.38, bf_withers=12.44, bf_average=12.21, mm=39.11kg, imc=23.15, status=Atenção).
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user (200)
POST /api/athletes creates athlete (PT schema: nome, sexo, altura_cm, idade, posicao) — 200

POST /api/athletes/{id}/evaluations with pregas+perimetros returns metrics object with all fields (bf_reilly_wallace, bf_evans, bf_jackson_pollock, bf_withers, bf_average, muscle_mass_kg, imc, mm_mg_ratio, status) — all values > 0
POST /api/users creates viewer (200); duplicate email returns 400; self-deactivation returns 400
POST /api/athletes/{id}/photos with multipart (file + date + kind) uploads to Emergent storage (200, 285 bytes)
Frontend: /login loads, login submits, redirects to / (dashboard)
Frontend: sidebar visible with new-athlete-btn, nav-users, toggle-theme-btn testids
Frontend: no console errors on login/dashboard load

failed.issue: 'nav-dashboard' data-testid missing on Dashboard sidebar link (link visually present as 'Dashboard'); other nav items (nav-users, nav-backup, nav-report) present
failed.evidence: await page.query_selector('[data-testid="nav-dashboard"]') returned null; screenshot shows Dashboard link is highlighted in sidebar

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='nav-dashboard' to Dashboard sidebar link in Layout/Sidebar component to match convention with nav-users/nav-report/nav-backup (does not affect functionality).
notes: Photo endpoint requires 'date' and 'kind' as form fields (in addition to file). Download endpoint uses ?auth=TOKEN query param (not Bearer header) — this is by design for usage. Frontend deep flows (create athlete full form, evaluation live results, weighin history/chart, goal target weight calc) not tested end-to-end due to first-finish latency scope; core routes reachable and no runtime errors observed. Recommend fuller frontend flow testing in next iteration.
